tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long las dngos su bstan pa'i dper brjod rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// shar pa'i la yig bskor ba'i rjes khrid// lo mar ldan pa'i la phug la bas dril// lo ma'i spyil bur le lo'i mal du nyal// lob lob mang po'i lad lo ling ling 'di// la ra lar shongs rnams kyi lo 'gros 'dra// lho pa'i lugs/ pha tshan kha tsha lba ba sbom// so sor thags 'thags sha tshod brtson// ha zhes kha las smra mkhas kyang*// gha dzha bzlo bzhin kha rtsub tsam// lho phyogs pa'i rab tu dang ba/ nyer 'tshe med par nyi mthongs 'gol po ru// dal gyis 'dug nas bza' bca' btung ba yis// lto ba 'gengs par gzhol ba'i bde skyid 'di// gnas skabs tsam du ngal bso'i stegs bu yin// shar phyogs pa'i rab dang*/ bsil ldan kha ba'i rdul brtsegs dri bzhon gyis// rim par gtsubs pa'i grang reg mtshon rnon pos// lpags pa 'bigs par gzas 'di dbyar min gyi// pho nya gtum po yin pas bag byos shig /shar phyogs pa'i mnyam nyid las/ snga ma 'jam zhing phyi ma rtsub pa/ nags 'dab myu gu gsar pa'i gos gyon pa// dal gyi 'bab pa'i rgyun la 'thung bzhin du// sngo ljang sgros sgeg rma bya'i khyu tshogs kyis// rtse dga'i 'khri shing phun sum tshogs dang 'dres// rkang pa gsum pa rtsub la gzhan gsum 'jam pa/ ma la ya las 'ongs pa'i dri bzhon gyis// 'dod ldan 'dod pa'i rims kyis btab 'di ko /chu srin rgyal mtshan bsgreng brtson sdig lta'i tshogs// ma lus 'char ba'i me long gnyis pa yin// gnas dang ring po dang brtsegs pa bskor ba// pad+ma spungs pa'i dpal mo dpal 'bar mo// kā la tsakra'i ka ya arta nam// sgra sgrog sgrar bskyed sgra ldan smin 'khyog lhas// bdag la bka' drin mdzod ces gsol 'debs rem// rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid las la bskor ba/ dpal mo'i mdzes sdug zla ris rdzogs pa'i sku// phal gyi mig la bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs de// gal gyi 'chu ba'i dka' bas nyer ston pa// bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu 'byin// tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid/

dga' ba'i dga' ston don gnyer skyes bu 'ga'// kha ba'i kha dog mtshungs pa'i so 'phreng dag yid 'ong yid kyi 'khri shing ngoms pa yis// lang shor langs pa'i sems 'di su yi 'jun// yi ge ring po'i rjes khrid de bskor ba// de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du mnyam pa nyid// de ltar yin mod ma rtogs blo ngo na// de nyid gzhan du snang ba'i log shes can// de dag snying rje'i mda' mo 'phangs pa'i 'ben// shar pa kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid rkang pa snga ma gnyis la rab dwangs pa ma/ phyi ma la lo dogs pa 'bigs/ ras pas ras dbyangs blangs rjes ras gur phub// rang sar don grub ra ros skyur gzi byas// tho co tho lob gzhob khyod 'o dod 'bos// kho bor gtso bos mchog stsol los yong mod// shin tu gzhon pa lho'i lugs brjod bde// gang zag dam pa bdag dang gzhan rnams la// phan mdzad dga' ba dar bas dad pa 'bar// gang zag ngan pa chang dang dga' ma la// yang dag dga' bas yang yang lta la 'bad// shar pa'i lugs brjod dka'/ sprin stug dkrigs pa'i mgrin las 'brug gi sgra// rtag par sgrog tshe rma bya'i sgro'i sgro gdugs// bsgrengs pa zlum por bsgrigs te tshad gsungs kyis// sgrib rnams gdung ba drag las sgrol phyir ro// don gsal lho ba'i lugs bde/ brtson pa chen pos thos bsam sgom gsum gyis// zhib mor gzhigs pa'i 'bras bu shes bya yi// rang tshul gsal ba'i mthong ba'i stong ldir las// skyabs gnas 'chol mi dgos pa'i dngos grub lon// shar lugs go mi bde ba/ rig pa'i gnas kyi khyad par mang po zhig /kho bo'i kha la byang bar rgyu 'di ko'i// rgyu dang rkyen gyi rnam pa ji 'dra zhes// phur bu'i blo gros kyis kyang brtag par dka'// lho lugs kyi rgya che/ sor gdub 'thab pa'i sgra dang lhan cig tu// pi wang dal bur sgrogs pa'i snyan 'gyur sgra// thos pa tsam gyis mi shes mun pa dpung*// khor yug ra ba 'gengs nas ga shed song*// shar lugs rgya che/

sku mdangs dkar bas zla ba'i mdzes pa phrog /gsung dbyangs snyan pas gling bu'i dpal las 'gengs// thugs mchog brling bas lhun po'i rjes 'gro ba// dbyangs can khyod las lhag pa'i snying sdug su// shar lugs kyi brjid pa'i tshig sdud/ dbyangs can lha dang ngag dbang rgyal po dag /rgyal dbang mkhyen mtsho'i dbyings las 'ong mod kyi// khyod gsung dag byed gaṅgā'i lha mo des// pad+ma dkar po'i spobs pa mchog tu sgrubs// lho lugs brjid pa'i tshig sdud/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs 'brug pa rje// slob mar bcas pa'i zhabs kyi rdul gtsang ma// spyi bor bsten pa kho nas skye gzhan du// skal ba bzang mod cig shos de lta min// mdzes pa las 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i gtam la sbyar ba/ pad+ma dkar po khyed kyi grags pa'i zer// phyogs kyi 'khor lo khyab 'di mkhas gzhan gyi// yon tan phyogs su 'gro ba'i go skabs kun// dog por dgag pa mkhyen ldan yongs kyis rtogs// 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtam dang sbyar/ de nas bzung ste kho bo'i mgrin pa 'di// dbyangs can lha mo'i khengs par bsngags 'os kyi// legs bshad drug ldan glu yi cha tsam yang*// thos pa'i blo gsal de rnams skal ba bzang*// bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ tshangs sras lha mo'i mkhyen rab ches che ba// zhib mor ma brtags kun gsal mdzes pa'i khyon// chung ngur 'chos pa'i byed po rmongs pa de// bsam gtan chang gis myos sam 'on te ci// ting nge 'dzin las spyir bstan/ bdud rtsi'i dra bas bsdoms pa'i 'od dkar can// shar ri'i thor cog ngos su brtse ba'i dus// pad+ma'i bzhin ras 'dzum yang kun+da'i nags// rnam par bzhad pas ze'u 'bru'i 'phreng ba ston// chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ nyi mas li khri'i khu ba skyugs pa'i bcud// 'dab ma bskyangs pas ngoms par 'thungs pas slar// myos pa'i ro dang lhan cig sbrang rtsi'i dbus// snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur zhing skyugs// chos mang po bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

mgrin sngon char rgyun mngal gyi khur lcid pas// yongs 'du 'khun sgra 'byin cing sa 'dzin che'i// phang du dal bus nyal ba'i rnam 'gyur 'di// legs byas gser gyi sbrum ma btsa' ba'i rtags// rang bzhin brjod pa'i rigs/ sgrib gnyis rnam par spangs dang tshogs gnyis kyi// dngos po yongs su rdzogs pas mkhyen gnyis rgyas// zag med chos kyi sku can longs spyod dang*// sprul pa sna tshogs 'char de rkang gnyis gtso// bya ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa thams cad pa// phyogs dus gar yang bskor ba'i sgra bo che// stong gsum kun tu khyab mdzad rlabs chen spyod// thog mtha' bar ma'i 'jig rten kun tu ngom// yon tan/ yan lag drug cu'i gsung gis rna ba la// mngon par 'khyud tshe rab dga'i spu long rgyas// cig car langs mthar chos mig rdul bral des// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sa la myur du reg /rdzas/ rung ba'i lhung bzed chos kyi gos rnam gsum// mkho ba'i yo byad lhag ma dang lhan cig /bsam gtan khang bur bza' btung ro brgya pa// longs la spyad mthar ril ba bh+rim gar 'dzin// chos dpe/ dpal ldan ngag gi lha mo dbyangs ldan ma'i// 'khor los mtshan pa'i phyag gnyis chos 'jam pa// chu skyes gsar pa bzhad pa'i dpal bzhin du// kun tu dmar ba'i ngang tshul gsal po 'dzin// dngos dpe/ rnam par 'dren pa'i dbang po shākya'i tog /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis rab brjid sku lang tsho// ngur smrig gos kyis klubs te lhun po'i ngogs// mtshams sprin gzhon nus dkris pa bzhin du mthong*// ldog dpe/ khyod thugs mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa// ji lta bzhin du pad+mo dga' tshal ni// 'dab ma'i 'phreng ba ches cher rgyas so zhes// lhar bcas 'jig rten gsum gyis mgrin gcig gleng*// phan tshun dpe/ dri za'i bu mo'i glu dang tam+bu ra'i// sgra dbyangs lhan cig sbyar ba'i 'gyur khugs bzhin// khyod gsung snyan 'jebs de bzhin rgyud mang dang*// na chung mdzes ma'i mgrin dbyangs bstun pa'ang mtshungs// nges dpe/

gzhon nur gyur pa'i 'jam dpal lhag pa'i lhas// rmongs pa'i dra ba mthar byed mthu'i dpe zlar// 'od stong spro ba nyin mo'i dbang phyug mas// gzhan pa'i dngos po srid 'dir 'ga' ma dmigs// nges med dpe/ rgyud mang ngos la sor rtse'i 'degs 'jog gis// rna ba'i bcud len sbyin dang dpyid kyi dus// ra yig gnyis pa'i klu ni khyod gsung mtshungs// de lta'i sgra snyan gzhan du srid na ko /bsdus dpe/ dbyangs kyi dbang mo'i bzhin ras mchog gi dpal// mdzes pa kho nas cha shas yongs gang ba'i// ston zla gsar pa'i rjes 'gro ga la ste// bdud rtsi'i thigs pas bsil ba bskyed pas kyang*// phul byung dpe/ dkar dmar mdangs kyis dbyes phye 'dren byed zung*// khyod gdong la 'khor dbang po'i tshon bkra ba// kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram par 'phyang las gzhan// tha dad 'byed chos ri bong rwa'i rno rtul// rab btags dpe/ khu bo dbon dang bcas pa'i mdza' gcugs tsam// nged la yod ces pad nyi snyems mi 'tshal// 'od brgya pa dang kun+da'i nags la 'ang*// de tshul snyon med mnga' zhes gtam du grags// rmad byung dpe/ 'od kyi pa ṭas bskor ba nyi zla'i lus// sna tshogs tshon gyi re khas klubs byas mthar// legs bshad tshogs kyi glegs bus 'gengs shes na// mi dbang zung gi dpe zlar 'ong ngam snyam// rmongs dpe/ gser sbyangs las bsgrubs dga' ldan bdag po'i sku// rin chen rang bzhin can gyi lhun po'i spor// nges par bsams nas nyin mo'i dbang phyug kyang*// de yi ngos su yang yang 'khor bar brtson// gtan la 'bebs dpe/ lhun po'i khengs pa thung ngur byed pa yi// lha chen khyod sku thub pa gangs can mtshor// sngon chad bsam mod spyan 'bras mi 'gul ba'i// gtan tshig 'di yis khro phu'i byams par nges// mnyam pa nyid dpe/ ma ma drug ldan mtho ris longs spyod dang*// bsung zhim dri yi lang tsho ngom de phyir// sa skyong dam pa'i bzhin ras dkyil 'khor ni// mo skyes bzhin du dpal kun tshogs pa la// smad pa'i dpe/

'jig rten mes po'i bzhin ras grangs lhag cing*// lag na rdo rje 'dzin de mig mang skyon// dpal mo'i dpa' yang gtum zhing gzu lum can// de slad khyed kyi dpe zlar de 'os min// bsngags dpe/ tshangs pa 'jig rten kun yang stobs ldan dgras// mtho ris dbang po'i dge mtshan bdag gir bzung*// dbyig gi lto ba 'jug bcu'i rol rtsed mkhan// de gsum khyod kyi mtshungs zlar chas pa bzhin// khyad par dpe/ dpag bsam nags su dal bur rgyu ba yi// phyogs kyi glang po'i dbang po rgyu rtsal gyi// bslab pas rab dus 'jigs bral smra ba'i mchog /gang la mnga' ba de nyid rgyal gyur cig /brjod bde dpe/ phyag na pad+mo can de yon tan gyis// brgyan tam 'on te skyon dang bcas kyang rung*// bshes gnyen khyod dang rnam pa thams cad du// mtshungs zhes smra 'dod bdag gi snying la gnas// 'gal dpe/ zla bas 'phel dang 'od yang tsha bo'i mdzod// dam pa khyod kyi thugs dam rnam gsum ni// phan tshun rnam pa tsam du 'gal te zhes// kho bos mthong zhing de ltar lags par 'khums/ dgag dpe// ba tshwas gang zhing rlabs kyi g.yo ba dang*// 'dzin 'khris gzung phyir chu yi phung po la// zab yangs khyod kyi thugs dang sgrun bzod pa'i// nus pa nyung zad tsam yang med par nges// mdzes dpe/ ngag gi rgyal po glegs bam ral gri dang*// rin chen 'phreng bas brgyan cing dpyod ldan khyod// pusta ka yis mgrin pa mdzes mod kyi// de lta na'ang phan tshun kun tu mtshungs// de nyid brjod dpe/ lha yi dbang phyug khyod kyi rnam dpyod 'di// kun gsal bu mo ma yin khyon yangs te// smra ba'i sgo 'khyug 'di yang sprin gyi lce// min no legs bshad bsgyur ba'i ljags rtse lags// thun mong min dpe/ mang thos sras dang chu yi thub pa yi// gter bum brgyad kyi'ang mtshon par mi nus pa'i// nor bu'i phung po 'di ni sa skyong ba// khyod rang nyid kyi mdzod dang mtshungs par go

/'byung min dpe/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i tshogs// ma lus gcig tu byed pos bsdus 'dra ba// smra ba yongs kyi dbang po dam pa khyed// blo gsal tshogs kyi dbus na bzhugs na kwa'i// srid min dpe/ kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ngos las me lce dang*// tig ta'i myu gu las kyang bur shing gi /sdong bu bzhin du khyod kyi mgrin pa nas// nyes par bshad pa'i rol mo ga la sgrog /mang dpe/ zla ba'i thigs 'phreng dang ni ga bur gyi// rdul brtsegs ma la ya yi rlung gzhon ltar// tshangs par spyod ldan khyod kyi tshul khrims dris// khor yug khyab par mdzad des skyong zhig gu /rnam 'gyur dpe/ yid 'phrog rgya ja'i mdangs 'di sin+dhu ra'i// rgya mtsho'i ngogs las phyung 'dra ro bda' ba// mtho ris bdud rtsi'i snod las 'phral nyid du// skyogs kyi bcus pa'i khu ba gsar pa bzhin// phreng dpe/ zla bas mtsho bzhin de yi chu skyes dang*// pad+mas ge sar de yi sbrang rtsi'i bu// bzhin du mi bdag khyod kyi bsod nams kyang*// nyin bzhin gong du 'phel 'di dga' ba la// bzhin sgra gcig mgon po khyod sku mthing nag brjid chags pa// lhab lhub dar dpyangs nag pos klubs 'di ni// gnam lcags 'bab pa'i ri bo ma la ya// char sprin stug pos 'khyud pa bzhin du sgeg /du ma/ sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho ji bzhin de yi bcud// shin tu mngar ba bzhin du snyan tshig 'phreng*// ngur pa'i mdza' na mo bzhin bdag nyid kyi// myangs bzhin myangs bzhin snyan pa'i skad 'byin te// zla bo dngos po/ zab dang dkyel che'i legs bshad phung po'i tshang*// blo gros 'khyog pos rtogs par dus min te// chu sring 'byung ba'i gdan kyi gting dang mtha'// mthu stobs ngan pa dag gis ga la dpogs// mtshungs sbyor dpe/ spyan stong mnga' bas sum rtsen dpal dang ni// mi yi dbang pos nor 'dzin longs kyis spyod// de yis 'chi bral bag med la bskul zhing*// khyod kyi dā sa bde bar 'jug la spyod// rgyu dpe/

mkhyen yangs pha mtha' bral bas nam mkha' dang*// shes bya'i gnas kun gsal phyir nyin mo'i mgon// 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba'i 'dren mchog khyod// ston zla lang tsho dar ba'i rjes su 'gro// gzugs can rgyan gyi bsdus pa/ dad stobs chu ba rab brtan snying rje'i mchog /yongs rdzogs shes bya rab spang spyan dkyus ring*// smin legs rnam par sgeg ldan ḍā ki nī// nye bar bzhad gad puṇ+ḍa ri ka 'ong*// ma bsdus pa/ yun du sbyangs pas shes bya'i zhing khams kun// rmongs pa'i yol ba stug po bros pas sgribs// da ko shes rab ral gri'i snang ba che// rnyed de dum bu dum bur byas ta re// bsdus shing ma bsdus pa/ mchu sgros 'dab yangs so 'phreng ke sa ra// 'dren byed bung ba zung ldan gdong pad can// lang tshos snyoms pa mtho ris me na ka'i// stang stabs 'di ni dga' ba'i rdzing bur rtsen// mtha' dag gzugs can/ rnam dpyod 'od dkar khu bas yongs bkrus pas// blo gros kun+da bzhad pa'i 'dzum bar nas// legs bshad ze 'bru ngom la ches dpa' ba// gang de bsod nams mtsho las gzhan pa su// cha shas/ a ho gzhon nu ma yi bzhin gyi ngos// smin ma'i 'khri shing las dpyangs ut+pal mig /rdzi ma'i 'bras bu bstar la chags can gyi// bung ba 'dab ldan gar gyi rnam par 'tsho// cha shas can// mdzes ma khyod lus pad+mo'o lcug phran ldem// mkhrang zhing cung zad 'bur ba'i nu ma mdzes// 'jam mnyen dkar ba'i phyag ldan skra'i lan bu// rnam par 'khrugs 'dis lang tsho dar bar mtshon// yan lag gcig smra ba kun gyi lha mo dbyangs ldan ma'i// mkhyen yangs zla ba'i khu ba rab dkar bas// legs bshad don du gnyer ba'i tshogs rnams kyang*// gnag pa min pa'i go 'phang mchog la bkod// yan lag gnyis/ pi wang snyan par bsgreng mdzad dri bzang mo'i// dkar 'jam phyag gi yal ga la 'khyud pa'i// rin chen gdub kor lo 'dab rnam rgyas de'i// 'od kyis srid gsum kun nas snang bar mdzod// yan lag sum pa/

brgyad gnyis lang tsho 'bar ba'i bzhin gyi ngogs// mchu sgros 'dam skyes 'dab brgya'i rgya grol bar// spyan zur bung ba 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog 'dis// 'dod ldan sbrang rtsi'i dog pa cis mi 'phel// ldan gzugs/ sgra dbyangs lhag pa'i lha mo'i bzhin mtshar las// mchu sgros pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'dzum mul bar// tshems dkar bung ba'i khyu tshogs 'khor ba yi// bcom ldan khyod ni 'gro ba'i ma ma'o// ldan min gzugs/yid 'phrog dkar 'jam mthong ga'i ngos yangs por// nu 'bur dpal gyi 'bras bus nyer mtshan las// 'o ma'i rgyun bzang ga bur thigs pa ni// dal bur 'bab 'di skye 'gro'i bsos su smin// mi mnyam pa/ dgra la rngams pas khro gnyer cher bsdus nas// smin ma'i me dpung drag pos gar bsgyur ba// ma hā ka la khyod gdong bskal pa'i mun// 'thibs por gyur pa'i mtshon chas ru tra gtubs// khyad par can/ drag shul cher 'chang 'khor tshogs lhab lhub gos// rnam par klubs pa'i rtse mor dregs pa'i gtso// bya rog mtshan can ke tu rab brjid pa// thub bstan mel tsher bsnyen na mchog tu dge /yang khyad par can// ma pham rgyal sku lhun po mngon mtho ba// sna tshogs mtshon rgyas rab spud pho brang gi /gling bzhi'i dbus su bkod 'di lha mi kun// dgos med dge ba'i rol mo ci yang 'khrol// 'gal gzugs/ rta ljang shing rtas nam mkhar mi rgyu zhing*// kun+da'i nags klung zum par mi byed pa'i// 'jam mgon khyod zhal nyi ma'i gzi byin 'dis// bdud sder mun pa spro ba'i cho 'phrul bstan// rgyu gzugs/ mkhyen pa'i snang ba 'gyed pas nyin mo'i mgon// brtse ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs nya'i zla ba// nus pa thogs med dbang po'i rdo rje ste// 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba'i gangs kyi ri// sbyar gzugs/ ma ma pad+ma can zhal khyod kho na// chu bya'i tshogs dang dzo gis spyad 'os kyis// bsung zhim phyogs brgyar 'thul 'di rkang drug pa// yongs kyi thun mong nyid du don gnyer byos// chos kyi tshom las blo gros tshogs 'bar bas// khebs pa khyod kyi thugs mchog dbang chen mtshan// zab yangs chu yi srin po'i grong khyer la// mngon par 'gran ces brjod pa dpe'i gzugs can// rta gdong 'od kyis chu gtor chen po dang*// bdag blos gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yongs su 'thungs// snga ma dba' rlabs g.yo bas mi brtan yang*// 'di de'i gcig shos ldog pa can gzugs can// 'gog gzugs/

dga' ldan dbang po'i byams thugs ga bur gyi// rdul mang brtsegs pa'i zegs ma'i yid srubs kyi// khro ba'i me dpung 'bar la ches sdang pas// byams pa'i dpal zhes brjod pa rigs ma yin// mnyam 'jog 'jam mgon dpal gyi mdzes sku mkha'i nor bus// snying brtse rab gtang mun pa'i bu mo'i khyu// rmeg med bcil 'di khyod dang 'od 'phreng gi /skyon du ma zad mig sman dag gi'ang yin// gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ blo gros nags klung sprin tshogs dkrigs pa las// lung rig seng ge'i gad mo 'brug dbyangs kyis// smra ngan lag ldan snying rtsa g.yo ba'i gar// dal ba min pa bsgyur la da sdod bkos// bsnyon dor gzugs can/ rab yangs 'di ni thugs min lha'i rdzing ring*// rab gsal 'di ko blo min nyi zla'i 'od// rab tu mang 'di yon tan sna min gyi// rab 'byams skra tshogs phung por spungs pa lags// thog ma'i rigs kyi gsal byed/ shes rab kyis ni don dang mi ldan pa'i// bya ba ngan pa phal cher rab tu 'gog /tshig skam nyi tshes rlom pa rtog ge'i yang*// khengs pa gsar du 'phrog pa'i spobs pa thob// thog ma'i bya ba gsal byed/ khyab par byas so rgya mtsho'i bla gos can// 'od stong 'bar ba'i snang ba mchog gis te// ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor lo yangs pa'i khongs// khyod kyi grags snyan rnam par dkar bas so// yon tan gsal byed thog ma/ rnam par rgyal po phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa ste// blo gsal tshogs kyi mgrin pa'i lam yangs por// legs par bshad pa'i phung po chen po yang*// rdzas thog ma'i gsal byed// byams mgon bdud bzhi'i g.yul las ma pham pas// gtum chen khong khro'i phreng ba mi bzad pa// nye bar phrogs gang snying rtse'i dpal thams cad// blangs pa khyod nyid kho na'i dbang du gyur// bar gyi gsal byed las rigs/ rig grol spobs pa rab mtho ngur smrig gi

/rgyal mtshan zlum por bsgrengs pa'i rab byung grags// chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyud mang sgrog rnams snying*// me tog mda' yis 'bigs pa ma gyur grang*// bar gyi gsal byed las bya ba/ chags bral ring nas sgoms la yid srubs kyi// mtshon cha ji tsam rno yang nyer zhir 'gyur// khro bas rab bsnun tshig gi phreng ba yang*// bzod stobs go char ldan pa rnams la'o// bar gyi gsal byed las yon tan/ dpyid kyi dpal mo'i lang tsho don dogs pa bas pa/ myu gu gsar pa'i 'phreng bas kun tu sngo// chu ris 'khyog por srub pa char sprin gyi// phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'gram pa de yang ngo*// bar gyi gsal byed las rdzas/ phyir rgol lta ngan nyer 'dzin mu stegs kyi// log smra'i spobs pa phrog pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// bka' btags chos kyi phyag rgyas 'jig rten gsum// rang gir 'dren pa'i dbang phyug khyod zhabs snyen// mtha'i gsal byed las rigs/ rkang 'thung 'dab 'phreng rgyas pa'i nags klung du// dal bur 'bab pa'i chu phran rlabs g.yo zhing*// khu byug bu mo'i glu dbyangs kyis rna ba// skal bzang 'gyur 'di dpyid kyi pho nya'o// mtha'i gsal byed las bya ba/ lha sras gzhon nu snyan ngag mkhyen dang gcig /lce mang pad+ma'i sbubs su 'thums dang gnyis// dge sbyong rgan pos ri khrod zin rnam gsum// dus kyi pho nya'i lo la mnyam du grub// yon tan/ dal bu dal bur rgyu ba'i dri gzhon gyis// sngo ljang 'dab tshogs g.yo ba'i lding khang du// cong cong skad gdangs g.yo ba'i 'gyur khugs mkhan// yid 'ong ko gi la de skal ba bzang*// rdzas mtha' gsal/ don dang rjes 'brel med kyang phrag dog gis// dgra zun rnam dbyer mi phyed dben spyi ba'i// spobs pa lan brgyar phrogs nas rang blo dpal// rgya cher ngom te mi yi dbang phyug zung*// phreng ba'i gsal byed/ ngag la dbang ba'i lha mos shes pa'i rab// 'phel bar byed de de kos legs bshad 'phreng*// des kyang pusta ka ste des rgyal bstan// des ni 'gro gsum 'di yi phan bde'i dpal// 'gal don gsal byed/

smin legs dbyangs can ma yi bzhin ras 'od// rnam par bkra bas dad ldan blo gsal byed// yid kyi srub shing snying la mun pa'i gos// 'thug por bgegs pas blo gros sgrib par byed// don gcig pa'i gsal byed/ reg bya bsil bar ldan pa'i char rgyun gyis// myu gu'i 'phreng ba 'phel zhing mi gtsang rdzab// kun nas bkru dang chab kyi rdzing bu rnams// rgyas par byed pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung brtsams// sbyar ba'i gsal byed/ dri bzang phreng bas khor yug 'gengs nges shing*// bcud kyi 'byung khungs gting zab yangs pa'i rgyan// rab dkar 'dab brgya pa ni rdzing bur te// thams cad gzigs de mos pa de de'i ngor// don skor/ dbyangs can mthu yi shes rab rnam par 'phel// zla ba'i sring mos blo gros mchog tu bskyed// tshangs pa'i bu mos spobs pa rgya cher dbye// mtsho ldan ma yis rnam dpyod lhag par gsal// tshig skor/ sngo ljang lo ma'i lding khang yid 'ong des// drang por srong ba'i yid rab dga' bar byed// shel gyi 'bab stegs gtsang ldan yid 'ong des// chu skyar gzhon nu'i yid rab dga' bar byed// gnyis ka skor/ gtsug lag rgya mtshos ngom pa mkhas pa'i dbang*// gzhung lugs shes nas 'chad pa mkhas pa'i dbang*// pusta ka yi don rig mkhas pa'i dbang*// glegs bam rgya chen 'grel mdzad mkhas pa'i dbang*// 'das pa'i 'gog pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig gis ji snyed pa'i// shes bya thams cad ma 'dres cher gsal bar// mngon par rtog zhes smra 'di bden min tshig /'on kyang dngos po'i rang mthus bsam mi khyab// da ltar 'gog pa/ mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis sgeg ldan lha mo khyod// rin chen rgyan dang na bzas spud nas ci// dkar mdangs dmar ba mtshan dpe'i lang tsho yis// sems ldan kun gyi yid kha phrog min nam// ma 'ongs 'gog dbyangs can mgrin par 'phos pa'i snyan ngag mkhan// don sgra gab tshig rgyan sbyor 'god pa la// kun tu rmongs pas glags rnyed mi 'gyur te// shes rab snang ba 'gag pa ga la srid// chos 'gog

mi pham mgon po khyod kyis khams gsum kun// byams pas skyong zhes grags mod de lta rdzun// gal te bden na bdud dang log 'dren rnams// mthu stobs mtshon chas 'bigs pa 'di ci zhig /chos can 'gog pa/ gshin rje'i pho nyas 'jigs rung kha gdangs shing*// lcags sreg sa gzhir rtsub mo'i mtshon brdar nas// khro chu drag por bskol kyang der skye ba'i// rgyu med phyir na bdag sems ga la g.yo// 'bras bus 'gog shes par rab kyi snang ba cher 'bar zhing*// brtson pas sbyangs stobs spobs pa mi dman la// dam pa'i mgon gyis zin kyang da dung bdag /mkhas pa'i go 'phang ma thob 'di ci 'dra// rjes gnang 'gog smin legs bcom ldan ma khyod zhi ba'i gnas// stug por 'jug bzhed mchis na der myur bzhud// kho bo mun pa'i khung bur gti mug gi /gnyid kyi bde bar gzhol la dogs mi 'tshal// dbang 'gog rnam par 'dren khyod gang du bzhud pa'i sar// longs spyod 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang 'phrin las kyi// gdugs dkar g.yas su 'khyil la som nyi med// 'on tang zhing 'dir rtag par bzhugs shig kwa'i// ma gus pas 'gog pa/ kho bo gzhan don dge ba lhur len gyi// rang nyid zhi bde sgrub la yid mi rton// mgon khyod zhi bar gshegs sam 'dir bzhugs pa// ji ltar dgyes pa bzhin du mdzad rigs so// shis brjod kyi 'gog rnam 'dren khyod ni dag pa'i zhing gzhan du// gal te gshegs par 'dod na de bzhin mdzod// sa bcu'i lam la kun tu bkra shis shing*// khyod gzung zhing der bdag kyang skye bar smon// rtsub mos 'gog dbyangs can 'thug por bkod la thugs gzhol ba// gal te bden par bzhed nas sa bcu pa'i// sems pa che 'ga' 'khor du bsten 'os kyi// ma dag gdul bya bdag 'dra 'bor bar zad// gros gyi 'gog tshangs sras gal te bzhud na myur du bzhud// phyis nas 'khor bar 'khor bar sems can rnams// khyod dran tshor bas mnar ba'i cho nge'i sgra// nyid kyi snyan du zhugs pas gegs byed 'gyur// 'bad par 'gog pa/

khyod thugs dgyes pa 'phel phyir gshegs shig ces// gleng 'dod bsam pa bdag la yod mod kyi// rang 'dod snying por goms pas bzhugs zhes tshig /kha las 'thon 'dir bya thabs ci ste yod// gzhan dbang gis 'gog rgyud mang 'dzin de gzhan du thegs 'dod ces// gsungs mod khyod zhal lta la gegs byed pa'i// 'od 'phreng 'bar la'ang khyu ba'i dad stobs kyis// gzhan dbang can la de dang bgro bar 'tshal// thabs 'gog dbyangs can khyod dang bral ba'i gdung ba ni// re zhig bdag gis bzod par rngo thogs mod// sgrib gnyis sbyang dang tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs la// 'bad mi dgos par grol ba'i mchog stsol zhig /khro 'gog mgon po rab zhi'i gnas la thugs gzhol zhes// lan mang 'dzer 'di 'gro la snying ring po// slad nas gnas 'dir rgyun du stan chags kyang*// snying rjes dman des bdag la ci zhig bya// mya ngan nam snying rjes 'gog mtshon chas ma bcun dug chus ma bcom zhing*// byin zas ma bsregs rlung gis ma gtor bar// kun tu rmongs pa'i dngos po ma lus pa// rnam par nyams pa'i brtul zhugs dag la bkod// 'gyod 'gog 'khor dang longs spyod sgrub thabs ma bslabs shing*// rig pa'i gnas la 'dris par ma byas la// dben par mnyam par 'jog pa'i long med par// lang tsho yol ba 'di ko snang ba skyo// the tshom 'gog sgra dbyangs snyan 'jebs 'di ko bung ba'i skad// yin nam 'on te dri za'i glu'am ci// ci ste nor bu'i sor gdub 'khrol ba'i sgra// 'dra phyir rkang pa drug pa'i dbyangs ma yin// sbyar 'gog chos kun rnam par dpyod dang so sor rtog /gzhal bya nye bar 'jal ba'i grub mtha' ba// rang bzhin gnas pa'i dbyangs can 'di yin phyir// rgyud mang bsgrengs pa'i bud med des ci bya// don gzhan 'gog ji snyed chos tshul mkhyen nas mi tshim par// da dung thos pa 'tshol la ring par chas// 'on kyang rgya mtsho 'thung ba'i rgod ma kha// da dung ma ngom me lce 'bar la ltos// rgyus 'gog

phan bde kun gyi spyi gzhi rgyal ba'i bstan// kho na yin te de las snyon du med// de lta na'ang skye bo rang rang gi /skal bas thob pa nyid du rnam par bsam// kun khyab don gzhan bkod/ chos kyi rgyal thabs chen po lha rtse ba// rab zhi'i dbyings su bzhud la mya ngan ci// ji snyed chos kun de lta'i gnas tshul la// gzhan du 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs su yis 'grub// khyad par/ 'gro rgyud kun tu rmongs byed dri ma'i tshogs// 'gog phyir skyes bu chen por grub min nam// sems med na yang char gyis nor 'dzin ma'i// bzhin gyi nag nog kun tu bkru bar byed// sbyar ba can/ kun la bzod pa'i go cha'i sran tshugs na// 'jig rten dga' ba 'phel ba'i rgyu rkyen sbyor// dpyid kyi lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug gis// 'od ldan skye bo'i yid ga 'phrogs la ltos// 'gal ba can/ u dum wa ra rdul mang gis rnyogs kyang*// gser gyi khu ba lhug par 'dzag ces bsngags// mi gtsang 'dam rdzab las skyes mā li ka /chen po rnams kyi'ang ral pa'i rgyan du len// mi 'os byed/ mkhas dbang mgrin pa'i lam las nyer brgyud pa'i// legs bshad mngar ba'i ro yang tshwa skyur du// bro zhes spong ba'i 'du shes lhur len pa// bdud kyis brlams pa yongs kyi mi dge'i las// 'os byed/ bai ḍūr dkar po'i rgyud mang las byung ba'i// glu dbyangs snyan pas dbang po yongs gdung byed// 'di ni rdzun bral dngos te legs bshad kyi// sgra don gnyer rnams dran pa slong ba'i phyir// 'os shing mi 'os pa/ shes kyang blun po'i bya bar 'du byed na// rmongs rnams gang 'byung brten par cis mi byed// rnam rig bkra bas gya tshoms spyod pa na// mi mkhas gzhan dbang can rnams lta ci smos// gcig gi ldog pa can/ dkar mdzes yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i zer 'dzag phyir// dbyangs kyi rgyal mo khyod dang ri bong can// mtshungs mod 'on tang mtshan dpe'i dpal 'dzin slad// khyod kyi dpe zla gnyis skyes de mi rung*// gnyis ldog

chu srin 'byung ba'i gnas dang dbyangs can ma'i// thugs mchog zab dang rgya che mtshungs lags kyang*// chu gter dma' ba'i sar 'khyil lha mo khyod// rab mtho'i go 'phang la 'gying tha dad chos// sbyar ba'i ldog pa can/ srid pa'i gnas skabs kun tu khyab cing 'jug /pha rol spobs pa 'phrog la dpa' ba'i rgyu// mi yi seng ge khyod dang ri dwags rgyal// mtshungs mod lha dang dud 'gror skyes pas dbye// ldog pa can gyi 'gog pa/ mthon po rab 'phags 'od phreng ches snum pos// khongs yangs 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor dge legs su// byed mod mi brtan g.yo ba'i nyi zla des// mi dbang khu dbon gnyis la 'gran nus min// gtan tshig gi ldog can/ rnam par dpyod pa'i thugs ni dkyil che zhing*// legs par bshad pas mgrin pa yongs gang mod// nga rgyal ldan phyir lha yi bla ma de// snyan dngags mkhan po drug las brtul zhugs dman// don gyi bod pa'i ldog pa can las dpe dang dpe can gyi dbye ba tsam/ mi dbang chen po khyod kyi gzi byin dang*// gdung byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag gi khyad// nyin byed kun gsal mdzes ma'i phangs par nyal// gzi byin rgyal po'i sku la rnam par 'khyud// dpe las dpe can lhag pa/ zla ba'i gdong la rab dmar thig le dang*// 'dren byed mtshar ba'i ri mo bris pa med// brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bzhin la chos de gnyis// lhag por mnga' bas mdzes pa skyes pa lags// mtshungs chos dang 'byed chos gnyis ka can/ ke la sha dang lha mo khyod kyi sku// rab tu dkar zhing 'od snang spro ba ste// ri ngogs chu khur can gyis kun nas dkris// mdzes sku dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis bkra// 'byed byed can/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa bsam gtan rgyan// stobs 'byor rgyal po chen po mnga' 'bangs rgyan// bstan 'dzin lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can// mi bdag bsod nams phung po rab mthor brtsegs// rigs mthun byed pa'i ldog pa/

sos ka'i nyi zer rnon pos mi 'tshig cing*// dbyar gyi gru char drag pos mi dag pa// lang shor blo yi dri ma ngan pa 'dis// dkar po dge bcu'i spyod pa yongs su bsgribs// rgyu cung zad la ltos pa'i srid pa can/ g.yul du ma zhugs par yang dgra dpung bcom// rigs sngags bzlos pa med par bgegs kun 'bros// sman dpyad ma brten par yang nad zhi ba'i// sngon med brtse ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu la ma ltos pa'i ngo bo// brtsegs pa min yang bsod nams mngon par mtho// ma sbar blo gros me chen mchog tu 'bar// ma bsgrubs par yang 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa// 'di yis mkhyen ldan yongs kyi yi ga 'phrogs// spyi'i bsdus brjod/ yi ge bral ba'i skad kyi klag cor can// mar gad 'dab ldan nags klung bde bar rgyu// smra mkhas ne tso lcags kyi sras bu dang*// 'grogs te za ma tog las 'gong dbang mod// khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod/ gsal stong sgrib pa rab bral mtha' mi mngon// bgrang yas shes bya kun gyi rjes 'gro bas// brtan g.yo 'jug dang ldog pa'i go 'byed mkhan// nam mkha'i klong 'dir 'dab ldan phur zhing lding*// khyad chos tha dad pa'i bsdus brjod// mnyen lcug 'dab ma'i 'phreng ba yid du 'ong*// ge sar gzhon nu tshogs pa'i dpal yon can// bsung zhim ngad kyi khor yug 'gengs mdzad khyod// dam pa'i spyan sngar rngom brjid bgyis par 'os// sngon med bsdus brjod/ ri dwags tshan mas dri mar ma byas shing*// dmar phyogs 'grib pa'i rnam 'gyur mi ston pa'i// sngon med zla ba 'di ni tshig mtshams su// kye ma srid gsum rnam rgyal khar rgyu'o// khyad par phul byung*/ rin chen rnam bzhi'i 'od 'phreng phyogs brgyar spro// dpag tshad brgyad khri langs der lha'i mtshon ris// ring por dpyangs pa ri dbang lhun po des// khro phu'i byams chen sku la mtshon nus min// the tshom phul byung*/

khor yug dang bcas rgya mtsho'i gos can la// bka' btags phyag rgyas dbang bskur rgyal po khyod// go 'phang rab mthor brtsegs pa'i steng de na// nam mkha' yod med ci zhes som nyi thos// phur bu'i blo ldan zhi des ngang tshul can// badz+ra sā dhu'i thugs la khong khro ba// yod dam med ces som nyi'i lding khang du// bdag sems khyogs la dpyangs pa su yis zlog /nges pa'i phul byung*/ bsod nams phung po'i rtse ni nyin rer yang*// gong du 'gro ba'i go skabs dbye mthong phyir// khyod kyi bla na kun gsal mdzes ma'i gdong*// nges par yod ces kho bo g.yar dam len// 'di yang nges/ mi zad snying stobs dpa' ba'i 'gying stabs kyis// phyi rgol dgra bo'i spobs pa nyer 'phrog pa'i// gtan tshigs yang dag mthong slad khyod thugs la// khro ba'i mtshan ma yod par da gdod khums// grags pa'i phul byung*/ 'chad dang rtsom la mkhas pa'i dbang po'i thugs// lung dang rig tshul rgya mtsho'i khengs pa'i lcid// g.yo med 'degs par bzod pa'i nor 'dzin ma// ngal ba'i 'khun bu mi 'byin ches ngo mtshar// sems ldan rab rtog snyan ngag gzhung la rab sbyangs blo nor can// mang pos khyod thugs spobs pa phrogs dogs nas// shel gyi rgyud mang sgra yis pha rol sems// 'brid mkha' g.yo rgyu ldan des dbyangs can ma// 'di yang*/ smra ba'i rgyal khyod mtshan don ldan na ko /khro gtum ral gri ci phyir gzhan la brdeg /dri za'i bu mos khyod kyi shes rab la// 'gran 'dod de la 'debs phyir phyar bar nges// sems med rab rtog dpyid dus nyi zer rnon pos gnam sngon ni// khu bar rab bzhu 'khyil ba'i me long du// zla ba'i bzhin rgyas snang 'di kun gsal las// phu nu yid gcugs gnas la bkod pa bzhin// 'di yang*/ bdud rtsi'i 'od brgya dra ba'i gur khang nas// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan shar tshe pad+ma'i 'dab// zum par gyur la ku mud ze'u 'bru// 'phyas gdags rgod pas so phreng ngom pa snyam// yid dga'i skyed tshal mdzes byed rkang 'thung gi

/yas gas blo gsal tshogs la mgron stob mthar// mgrin pa ring por brkyangs te rtsa gsum pa'i// rtsed 'jo'i longs spyod dag la blta ba snyam// yal ga klung gis dal bur bskyod pa'i sgra// thos bsam 'khor lo'i dbyangs kyi gnyid dkrogs na// nyer dub nyin dang mtshan mo cher ring zhes// sgyid lug shugs rings yang yang glal ba snyam// rtse mos nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'bigs pa bzhin// yal ga rgyu skar tshogs la nom pa bzhin// lo mas chos kyi dril chen sgrogs pa bzhin// 'bras bus ras bal char du 'bebs pa bzhin// snying la 'jam mgon bla ma bzhugs pa bzhin// gre bar dbyangs can lha mo 'khyil ba bzhin// ngag la daṇ+ḍi'i rol mo 'phos pa bzhin// mgo la karma gan dkar bka pa bzhin// byed po'i dngos rgyu/ ngag la dbang ba'i lha mo dbyangs can mas// dal bur bsgyur ba'i rgyud mang sgra snyan pos// legs bshad chos su 'doms des blo gsal kun// dga' ba'i ba spu gos su gyon par gyur// nyams byed rgyu/ rab snyan glu dang sbyar ba'i dwo ra dang*// sor mo'i 'degs 'jog las mthon 'gyur khugs 'di// yid 'bab mchis 'brang dang bral 'dod ldan snying*// 'bigs byed dus kyi pho nya dang por 'ong*// rnam 'gyur rgyu/ legs bshad smra la mgrin pa mthor 'degs pa'i// rnam dpyod gsal ldan tshogs su 'du ba'i brdar// chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs 'di// sdig to can gyi snying dang rna ba'i dug /'di yang*/ thub pa'i khrims kyi rnga dbyangs bsgrub pa dang*// dge la rab bskul gaṇ+ḍi'i skad kyi gdangs// brtse ba'i gzhan dbang can gyi bslab bya rnams// glo snying rul ba rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs// thob bya'i rgyu/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i khri 'phang rab mtho'i steng*// myur du 'dzeg par bzhed pa'i blo can rnams// ji snyed shes bya'i stegs bu 'tshol ba'i thabs// rnam par sems la ngal ba dang du len// 'di yang*/

snyan tshig mtshar du dngar ba'i do shal ni// ring po mgrin pa'i rgyan du ngom pa'i phyir// thos ldan bsam pas sbyangs pa'i blo gros kyis// dbyangs can zhabs kyi pad+mo bsnyen la 'grus// shes byed las go byed rgyu/ sngo ljang myu gu gsar pas skyed mos tshal// legs par brgyan pa'i dge mtshan lta phyir du// mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur ba'i ko ki la// yid 'ong 'dab ma ngom zhing slebs dus 'dir// nang go byed/ dran shes glegs bus dgag par mi nus shing*// bag yod gtan la bcug kyang mi khebs par// mi dge mtha' dag 'jug pa'i sgo chen po// las nyon 'du ba'i khyams su nyer bkod tshe// yang nang byed/ mkhas pa brgya yis rgol bar mi nus shing*// grub mchog stong gis co 'dri'i skabs mi rnyed// tshul ldan khrims kyang dpe zlar mi sgrun pa'i// gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i bdag po nam zhig thob// sngar nas med pa'i dngos rgyu/ nor lha bsnyen dang sgrub la mi 'grus shing*// chu lud sa bon 'dzoms pa'i zhing ma rmos// lho tshong byang sdeb ma nus khyim pa 'ga'// bzar med bgo ba med pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin// zhig pa'i dngos med/ rnam par g.yeng ba'i las la skyug log cing*// tshig phreng skam po'i tshogs la gus pa lhod// 'du 'dzi smig rgyu'i thang la yid byung bas// tshe zhabs dben pa'i ri la 'byid par sems// phan tshun med pa'i rgyu/ snyoms chung chos dang mthun pa'i zhi dul can// ji tsam tshogs kyang kha na ma tho'i dris/ ma reg phyir na de la klan ka yi// tshig tsam zhig kyang gleng bar su zhig spro// ldog pa bskyed byed rgyu/ lhag pa'i lha mo pi wang 'dzin ma khyod// rin chen skyed mos tshal du ma bzhugs pa// ma yin pa des dad ldan mig 'bras zung*// bdud rtsir byas pas spobs pa mchog tu dge /ring ba'i rgyu/ char rgyun drag po rgyun du babs pa des// lo tog 'dam chus bcom par ma zad kyi// las thabs chag pas nyin zhag 'phreng ba rnams// don med gyi na'i ngang du yol la gzigs// rgyu 'bras dus mnyam dpe/

bsod nams phung por phyur dang dus mnyam du// stobs kyi mnga' thang mtho bas srid pa'i rtse// zil gyis gnon pa'i dge mtshan bye ba snyed// stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten der gsal lo// 'bras rjes rgyu'i dpe/ tshig sbyor 'bum sde'i gnas la thugs byang bas// snyan ngag lang tsho dar la babs rjes su// gtsug lag lugs brgya gzigs pa'i blo gros kyis// lugs shes phur bu'i spobs pa phrogs so skad// rigs min rgyu/ mtshan dpe'i dpal gyi rjes 'gro dbyangs can ma'i// smin legs mdzes sdug rdzogs pa 'dren byed kyi// gzhal byar 'grims tshe 'dod pa'i me lce kun// rang sar zhi ba 'di ko ngo mtshar smad// rigs pa'i rgyu/ khyod zhal zla shel dkyil 'khor cha rdzogs las// nye bar zags pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od snum pos// blo gros mtsho chen gyen du 'phyur ba 'di// rigs pa'i lam dang mthun par zhugs pa lags// zur gyi phra mo/ dpa' bo'i rtsal dang rtul phod snying stobs can// stag chas drug gis brgyan pa'i skyes bu zhig /gzhu mdung nyag phran bsir ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phong gyi 'dun sar chen por zhugs par gyur// rnam pa'i phra mo/ cir snang sgyu ma'i 'khor lor byan tshud pa'i// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi dbang phyug rgod tshang pas// sra mkhregs brag ri phyag sor gyis bcad nas// dpe zla bral ba'i phug chen gsar du bsgrubs// 'di yang rnam pa/ pad+ma'i phreng can ma des tam+bu ra// mthor sgrengs tshangs sras lha mo'i zol gyis ni// kho bo dal med rnam g.yeng ngang rang las// mi tshe zad du 'jug pa'i sgyu ma sprul// spyir grags pa'i cha/ mtshan dpes rab brjid dga' ldan bdag po'i sku// mthong tshe ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma'i rgyun// 'dzag 'di me tog rdul dang bu ga'i rlung*// phan tshun gtsub las byung ba 'bras bur go /yang*/ tshogs dbus legs bshad phreng ba ngom pa la// glo 'gog lud pa lu ba'i sgra bsang 'dis// byang khog rnag gis bzos pa'i kha rlangs kun// longs spyod 'khor lo'i lte bar 'khyims pa sel// bstod pa ltar snang ba'i cha/

tshig 'jam nga ro ring pos 'jig rten dang*// nye bar bstun mkhas gshin rje chen po khyod// bya btang sprang po'i chos la mi dgyes par// seng ltar 'gying ba'i zab chos nyams su bstar// dmad pa'i bstod pa/ tshul khrims srung dang thos bsam dge chos la// bskul ba'i gtam gyi tsher ma rnon po de// rna bar btsugs nas tsit+ta 'bigs byed pa'i// brtse med bshes gnyen de 'dra khyi bas lod// 'di yang*/ kun gyi mdzes pa phrogs nas rang gir bzung*// drag po'i gtsug rgyan brkus nas stan du gting*// blo gsal rnams dang 'grogs pa'i bag yangs can// tshangs pa'i bu mo khyed la zhe nas khrel// rim pa can/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ni// lhun po tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang chu gter che// yid bzhin nor dang kun gsal mdzes ma'i khyon// sa gzhir g.yogs pa 'dra'o dbyangs can ma// dga' ba'i dpe/ dbyangs can mdzes sku 'od kyi pa ṭa ni// mthong bas lhag par dga' ba 'di tsam zhig /nges 'byed snying po gsar du mthong ba la'ang*// 'byung bar 'gyur min zhes pa drang po'i gtam// 'di yang*/ gshis legs dam pa bzang ba'i grogs po khyod// blo lhod grod pa 'jol ler nga'i gam du// sleb 'di'i dga' tsam gzhan gyis ster nus ci// slad du'ang yang yang phebs dang snying gi grogs// sgeg nyams/ kho bo'i tsit+ta 'od kyi za ma tog /shes byed dri za'i bu mo yid 'bab 'dis// blo yangs shes rab snang bas gsal byed pa'i// sgeg bcas gar gyis dpyod ldan dga' ba bskyed// drag shul/ khrag gis rab myo ka ka mu kha yis// dgra tshogs 'dus pa'i dpung las de'i gtso bo'i// mgrin pa zhags pas bcing ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ mtshon chas sdigs de gshin rje'i pho nya yin// dpa' nyams/ dbyangs can bsnyen pa'i hriṃ yig ma zlos shing*// slob dpon kha las rtsom rgyugs ma slangs la// glegs bam bklags pa'i tshul la mi 'grus par// snyan ngag mkhan 'gyur 'di ni sgyu ma'am ci// snying rje'i nyams/

dpal 'byor khri la re zhig rtse dgas rol// dregs ldan mgo la rkang pa'i stegs byas mthar// srid nyams gud pa'i pho nyas thang chad pa'i// rwa dza sa mthar bcings rnams snying re rje// 'di yang*/ kā la kung sa cha tsam mi bsgrun pa'i// nus ldan log pa'i 'tsho bas snying btsos rjes// gshin rjes rab 'phangs mkhris rlung zhugs pa yis// lcags bsregs 'tsher pa'i tshal du yud kyis drangs// rngam nyams/ tshil bcas rgyu ma'i mtshams sprin dmar po yis// mche ba'i zla tshes brgyan pa'i zhal sgo las// bstan dgra'i khrag rgyun dron mo 'dzag bzhin du// keng rus brtsegs pa'i khyams su gar byos shig /bzhad gad/ tshangs spyod rab ldan bu mo'i mkhur tshos ngos// so 'phreng bsnun pa'i ri mo gsar pa de// zla tshes bzhin du yid gar 'ong mod kyang*// 'on kyang smug rtsi'i thig les bsgribs na ang*// rmad byung nyams/ mkhas dbang khyod kyi bzhin bzang zla ba'i ngos// dkyus ring ut+pal mthing ka'i ri dwags mig /rin chen bdud rtsi'i thig 'phreng der chags pa// mthong 'di e ma bdag gi skal bas rnyed// 'jigs nyams/ mang du legs 'doms lung bzang rdo rje'i mtshon// rig pa'i me stag gtum po cher spro ba// mthong tshe log par smra ba'i lce dang snying*// lkog mar bros nas slar yang 'dar zhing dngangs// gzi brjid can/ 'jam pa'i dpal 'di log smra'i gshed ma zhes// dpa' 'khums snying la 'jigs pa 'dzin mi 'os// gang gi zhabs sen pad+mar skyabs 'tshol ba// de yi 'tsho sreg gzhan du ga la 'gyur// rnam grangs brjod/ 'du 'dzis dben pa'i phyogs su kho bo ni// ma ni pad+me'i rdog gsog byed du 'gro// mkhyen ldan dge la 'dun rnams chos grwa 'dir// ji ltar bzhed pa'i don rnams ci bder sgrubs// kun phan/ ngag dbang nam mkha'i nor bu 'od drwa can// chu ldan ri bo mal du mnal ba dag /dgu tshigs so'i 'dam la 'tshal 'dod tshe// rje btsun 'od dkar brgya ldan deng 'dir shar// bsam pa rgya che ba/

sna tshogs tsher phung khrod 'dir lus sems la// lan brgyar zug rngu 'byin pa khyad bsad nas// yongs 'dzin bka' rtags rgya las mi 'gong ba// 'di ko rdo ba'i ngos kyi re kha'am ci// 'byor pa rgya che ba/ gser bzang rgyu las lhun po gzugs gzhan pa// ma pham byams pa'i snyan shal dbang po'i gzhu// mog por bsgyur ba'i gtso blag mkhan po zhig /'jig rten byed po de yis gsar du bskrun// chos la snyon dor/ 'jam pa'i dpal khyod zur phud lnga tsam gyis// brgyan la de lta'i mdzes sdug ga la te// me tog phreng bas bcings pa'i zur phud ni// 'bum phrag du mas spud par gdon mi za// yul la snyon dor/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug snying la ral gri che// nges par brdegs pa'i snang tshul mthong bzhin du// ngag gi rgyal po 'gro ba thams cad la// rjes su brtse zhes smra ba rdzun pa'i chos// rang bzhin snyon dor/ bcu drug lang tsho 'dzin slad 'jam dbyangs khyod// gzhon nur 'jig rten 'di na grags mod kyi// gting mtha' mi dpog blo gros rgya mtsho che// rgan po'i rang bzhin dag las 'gyur ba med// tha dad min sbyor/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam la rgyu ba khyod// gdul byar gyur la bdud rtsi'i 'od rlabs bskrun// dkar gsal cha shas yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor gyis// 'jig rten yi ga 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu byas// tha dad/ 'jig rten snang bar byed pa 'od kyi ma// li kas 'khyud pa yid 'ong 'di 'chi ba// med pa'i lam la steng du nye bar bzhud// 'bab stegs gtsang byed bdud rtsi'i dga' char 'dod// bya ba gcig pa'i sbyar ba/ mgul ba'i lam las rgyu ba'i legs bshad dang*// rgyud mang gdangs las rgyu ba'i snyan 'gyur glu// sgra tshul chos su 'doms pa'i skal bzang gi /rna ba bdud rtsis 'gengs la mtshungs pa nyid// bya ba mi 'gal bas sbyar ba/ rnyed dka'i yid 'ong 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal kun// nges par skyob la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa// rin chen dbang gi rgyal pos dbul ba sel// ngag gi lha mos thar pa'i bde ba spel// bya ba 'gal ba'i sbyar rgyan/

sngo sangs ma dang gaṅgā'i 'jug ngogs de// dri bral kun nas dwangs par mtshungs mod de// nam mkha' bzhin mtshan steng du ngom pa dang*// skal ldan shing rta ngan 'gro'i lam du 'jug /nges bzung sbyar/ 'dab ma'i 'phreng ba bskyangs pa'i dngos po dang*// skye gnyis lang tsho dar ba gang lags pa// mdzes sdug phul gyis phyug pa dbyangs can ma'i// zur phud rgyan du g.yo 'di zla ba'o// nges par sbyar/ skye gnyis so yi 'phreng ba lags mod kyis// gdan du bting phyir 'od zer brgya par rigs// de yang ma nges pad mtshor rgyu ba yis// 'dab ldan ma ma'ang ming de bod par mthong*// 'gal min sbyar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba du ma'i mgon// gzi brjid che ldan legs par rgyu bas so// blo gros mchog tu rtsol ba mkhas pa'i dbang*// ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha mchog des skyongs shig /'gal ba can gyi sbyar/ pad+ma'i stan dang ldan yang tshangs pa min// mchod sbyin brgya phrag gtong yang lha dbang min// bdud rtsi'i zer dang ldan yang mdzad pa med// gzi byin 'od stong 'phro yang ku mud 'dzum// yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ ngang gi rab goms byams pa'i mtshon cha ni// rtsub min ngar ba ma yin rno ba'ang min// de lta na'ang srid pa'i dgra sde kun// dum bur gtubs pa 'di 'dra ches ngo mtshar// rigs/ 'jigs su rung ba'i ma hā ka la khyod// sha rjen za ba'i bden bral ma yin la// rngam byed mtshun gyi bdag po min kyang de// bstan dgra'i tshe srog phrog la lhag par dpa'// bya ba/ byams brtse'i snying por 'khyud pa'i dbyangs can mas// smin ma 'khyog po'i gar stabs ma bsgyur bzhin// mche ba'i zla tshes rngom brjid mi brtsom par// yid srubs dpung ba'i 'khri shing dral bar byas// rdzas/ rno ba'i mtshon cha sra ba'i go cha dang*// mgyogs pa'i rta dang stobs chen glang po'i sde// med kyang dben par gnas pas 'jig rten las// rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal rnga brdungs 'di mtshar// rgyu'i khyad par/

lha mo'i gdan gyi pad+ma rdul gyis rnyogs// zla ngos ra ris gang zhing phyi phyogs 'grib// dar zab srin bu'i kha chu mi gtsang yang*// dbyangs can lha mo'i nyi dogs pa rgyur song ste mtshar// mtshungs sbyor las bstod mtshungs/ mi yi bdag khyod mchod sbyin brgya pa dang*// phyag rgya'i ral gri me 'bar rtse brgya pa// mgyogs 'gro sa srung bu rnams pha rol gyi// dpung pa gnon la gcig tu mtshungs pa nyid// dmad mtshungs/ 'brug sgra myur pos 'phangs pa'i glog zhags dang*// ston gyi sprin dkar 'dzum pa'i dba' rlabs 'phrul// 'di snang rnam par bkra ba'i phun tshogs rnams// skad cig mi brtan g.yo ba'i rang nyams ston// gzhi tha dad bya ba 'gal ba/ rgyal bstan bshad dang sgrub pa dar drag tshe// dkar phyogs dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan brtan por bsgreng*// bdud tshogs skrag pas 'dar zhing dogs pa yi// ba dan de yang dal med rnam par g.yo// yon tan 'gal ba/ mgrin pa ngag gi dpal mos gang ba'i dbyangs// thos las blo ldan dgyes pas rjes chags shing*// mun pas snying ga rab 'gags glen pa'i khyu// legs bshad tshig gi chags bral brtulazhugs len// rdzas 'gal ba/ bzhin ras rnam par zlum la shangs dkyus rings// skra mtshams dbyes phye smin ma 'byar zhing stug /gtsug tor rab mngon gsang ba'i gnas mi mngon// zhi ldan thub pa de yis gzhan sems 'phrogs// tha dad pa'i las 'gal ba/ dran shes bag yod bslab pas nyer bsdams pa'i// rab zhi dul ba'i dpal gyi gzhan dbang can// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i drang srong des// gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i chos kun bya rigs sam// gzhi gcig bya ba 'gal/ dbyangs can byin rlabs gser gyi thur ma'i rtses// kho bo'i yid la reg pa min kyang kwa'i// blo gros 'dren byed dbye bas shes bya'i gnas// gsal por mthong ba'i skal ba bzang po thob// sbyar ba'i 'gal ba/

dam pa lhod pa'i ngang tshul mi yol ba'i// yal 'dab lnga dang legs bshad sdong bu zhig /dpung pa'i chu ba dag la rten 'cha' bar// rnam pa kun tu su zhig yid ston byed// skabs min ston pa/ gzhan sems bsrung ba'i ngal ba mi brten cing*// rdo ba'i phye ma chu dang bcas tsam gyis// bde bar rgyu ba bag yangs rgyu zhing mnal// 'dab ldan thi ba'i bu de skyid pa la// mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod/ nyam chung mi'u thung gi 'jig rten gsum// mnan nas stobs ldan sa 'og 'ching nus na// yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs dang ldan pa'i// mi tshogs dgra las rgyal bar mtshar ci yod// brtson 'grus/ brtul phod dpa' zhing 'dril ba'i snying stobs kyis// dgra bo'i phun sum tshogs kun phrogs nas slar// rang gi longs su spyod pa'i cho ga 'di// mi dbang khyod kyi blang byar rigs sam ci// stobs kyis zol/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal zhes dge mtshan gyis// lhun po'i spo la bsgrun par rigs min te// khyod zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa'i ri mo ni// rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi la bris pa lags// phan pa'i nges bstan/ bcu drug cha shas yongs gang 'od brgya pa// shar ri'i phrag par snang tshe ku mu da'i// 'dab ma'i phyag rgya grol na ke sa ras// sbrang rtsi'i dog pa phyogs bcu'i mgron la stabs// yang*/ mig sman bskyil ba'i rdzing bur bkrus 'dra ba'i// zur phud snum po'i ngo mtshar phreng ba can// kun nyon bud shing shes rab me lce yis// bsreg pa'i du ris steng du chags pa mtshon// gnod pa'i nges bstan/ mngon rlom ri bo brtsegs pa'i snying dbus su// nges par phan byed gtam gyi 'jug pa rnams// mi 'bab lus ngan phyogs lta'i phug nang du// nyi zla'i zer 'phreng 'gro 'ong ga la byed// lus med g.yo sgyus mngags pa'i mdza' na mos// tsit+ta'i khyim du sgrub pa'i cho ga yis// bshes gnyen du ma'i dul ba phrog pa'i brdar// rgyal bstan hrul por zhig pa'i ngang tshul bstan// yon tan lhan cig brjod/

dkar phyogs sha sha rda ra'i dkyil 'khor cha// phun tshogs dge ba'i dpal dang lhan cig 'phel// bdud rtsi rab bsil 'od brgya'i dra ba'ang*// grags pa'i ba dan mchog dang lhan cig dkar// bya ba tha dad lhan cig shes bya'i gnas kun mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// dbyar gyi chu bo bzhi dang lhan cig rgyas// de lta'i legs bshad thigs phreng zags pa rnams// lha yi 'thor 'thung chab dang lhan cig 'thor// bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig rnam par sgeg pa'i dbyar gyi lang tsho dang*// rtag min las kyi tshon ris bkra ba dang*// kun tu g.yo ba'i 'khor ba'i tshe srog rnams// 'jig pa'i gar stabs lhan cig dag tu bsgyur// yongs rjes/ mchog gsum ngo bo rab rdzogs bla ma rje'i// byin rlabs gzhan gyi snying la ster brtson kyang*// mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan bgrang yas kyis// pha rol sems kyi yi ga 'phrogs 'di ci// shis brjod/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i bcom ldan 'das// lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos// rig dang grol bar smra mdzad dge 'dun gyis// rnam dpyod mnga' ba khyod la shis pa mdzod// sgrub byed 'brel mtshungs kyi rab spel/ nyid zhal nya rgyas zla ltar ngos yangs la// spyan zung ut+pal mthing ga'i dkyus ngom phyir// ma skyed par yang g.yo ba'i ngang tshul des// dul yang brtan pa mi 'phrog ga la srid// stobs mtshungs rab spel/ rigs brgya lhun po rab mtho chos kyi grags// sam+bho ṭar mtshungs bya chen snyug 'dzin rgyal// ye shes snang ba'i rgyal mtshan nub mi srid// rtsom po byams pa'i mtshan gyi legs bshad tshogs// rkang pa dang po'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ lhag lhag 'od zer 'bar ba dpyid dus kyi// nyi mas gnam sngon gzhus pas 'khyil ba bzhin// khor yug ltar mi mngon pa'i yid bzhin mtsho// in+d+ra nī'i rlabs 'phreng kun tu g.yo// rkang pa gnyis par/ phyogs kun dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'phreng ba ni// phung phung mar gad lo ma'i gos bzang dang*// dri zhim me tog gsar pa'i rgyan mdzes pa// 'chi med 'dun sar lha yi na chung bzhin// rkang pa gsum par/

dri zhim ma li ka yi 'khri shing gis// dal bur bcing pa'i shel gyi lcug phran gyi// ldem ldem mgo lcog g.yo ba snye ma'i khur// stug por rgyas pas lci zhing thibs par gyur// bzhi par/ ljon shing 'ga' zhig snum ljang 'dab ma yi// gdu bu mdzes 'dzin yal ga'i lag pa dag /gyen du bsgreng las me tog dkar po'i char// chil chil 'bebs pas srid pa'i gdung ba skyob// bar ma chod pa gnyis la yod pa/ 'khyil 'khyil mar gad rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba'i rtser// lhag lhag dbu ba rab dkar brtsegs pa ni// chu klung mdzes pa rnams kyi mthong ka ma// mu tig do shal yid 'ong bkram pa bzhin// dang po dang gsum par yod pa/ ljang ljang 'dab ma brkyang ba'i 'phur lding gis// snying du sdug pa'i khu byug bu mo rnams// cong cong nags kyi khung bur glu len pa// mtho ris do ra'i bsil snyan dag dang mtshungs// dang po dang bzhi par/ long long char sprin g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug la// lta 'dod rma bya'i ze ba 'brel ba rnams// rab dga' 'jug ma bkram pa'i gar byed cing*// kyur kyur mgrin pa'i gling bu ci yang bsgyur// gnyis pa dang gsum par/ sbrang rtsi dngar rtsi chang gi yid myos nas// ling ling 'phur lding brtse ba bung ba'i kha// zir zir gre 'gyur phra mo'i glu sgra yang*// dri za'i pi wang bzhin du rna bar snyan// gnyis pa dang bzhi par/ shing gi gel par yib pa'i byi'u rnams// zil zil sbrang char zegs mas lus gsher te// nyi gzhon li khri'i 'od la 'dab ma dag /yang yang brkyang ba'i spu sdug yid 'ong 'dzin// rkang pa phyi ma gnyis la yod pa'i bar chod/ 'jam ljang rtsa yi mal du phru gur bcas// bag phab bde bar nyal ba'i ri dwags rnams// krong krong rna ba'i dbang po mthor btegs te// khyog khyog mgrin pa kyog pa'i mig gis lta// rkang pa gsum la yod pa'i nang tshan las dang po gsum la yod pa/

mer mer chu gter dang ba'i 'jug ngogs su// lhung lhung chab sgra snyan pa'i glu dbyangs can// breng breng chu klung mdzes pa'i lang tsho ma// sred ldan ngang pa'i tshogs rnams ca co 'phel// dang po dang gnyis par yod pa/ khrung khrung bzhad dkar la sogs chu bya rnams// phrom phrom g.yo ba'i dba' rlabs dkar mdzes kyis// rnga yab rtse mos 'thor ba'i chu thigs tshogs// zil zil 'bab pas 'dab ma mngon par gsher// gnyis pa la med pa/ chil chil rlabs phreng g.yo ba mu tig gi /phreng bas yan lag dkris pa'i chu skyar rnams// 'grig 'grig mtshar du dngar bar mtsho mtha' der// sil sil mgrin pa'i dril chung snyan par 'khrol// phyi ma gsum la yod pa/ dpal ldan ngang pa'i rgyal po dregs ldan rnams// lhang lhang mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung bzhin du// mthun mthun ngang mo mdzes pa'i khyo shugs can// lhab lhab 'dab shog bskyed pa'i gar gyis rtse// bzhi ka la yod pa/ 'dzum 'dzum ge sar g.yo ba'i chu skyes rnams// phrom phrom zil pa'i mchi ma rab 'phyis nas// zir zir bung ba gzhon nu'i khyu tshogs dang*// 'dar 'dar mgo lcog dud pa'i rtse dgas rol// bar chod kyi zung ldan rkang pa dang po gnyis la yod pa/ pad mtsho dwangs shing bsil ba de yi dbus// pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i sdong bu ni// lha yi tsan+dan brtul ba ga bur gyi// dri bsung 'jam po 'thul ba ge sar rtser// dang po dang gsum pa/ rab dang bsil zer 'od kyi dra ba ni// mu tig do shal mtshar du dngar 'dra bas// rab spras dri ma med pa'i gdan dbus su// lha mchog 'jam dpal rdo rje khyed 'khrungs so// dang po dang bzhi pa/ rab 'byams shes bya kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i gter// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum// ngag dbang lha mo bcom ldan dbyangs can ma// rab mdzes sku ni tsog pu'i tshul du bzhugs// bar ma/ rab dkar shel gyi lcug phran dang 'dra ba'i// zhabs kyi mthil dmar nyi ma'i me long gang*// zhabs sen li khri'i mdangs kyi spud pa des// dkar 'jam pad+ma'i lte bar mnyam par bkod// gnyis pa dang bzhi par/

zhabs sor ban+dhu'i 'khri shing myu gu'i 'phreng*// dmar ser thun mtshams li khri'i sprin gsar pa// sen 'od me tog bzhad pas chu skyes kyi// dmar ba'i mdangs kyang cung zad mog por byed// gsum pa bzhir/ 'khor lo dung dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u'i// ri mo rab gsal pir gyis bkod 'dra ba'i// zhabs zung byin gyis phra ba pad rtsa bzhin// zhabs gdub gser gyi dril chung sil sgra 'byin// dang po gsum pa/ dkar zhing dri ma med pa'i tshems kyi phreng*// dkar mdzes mu tig 'bras bus nyer mtshon pa'i// mchu sgros pad+ma'i khongs nas 'dzum 'od ni// dkar ba'i snang ba phyogs su 'grems pa bzhin// dang po dang gsum bzhir/ nyi ma'i rtsa lag 'dam skyes chun po yang*// skyengs byed lang tsho sgeg pa'i mkhur ba zung*// nyi 'od li khri'i mthun mtshams rtse dga' can// nyi ma gzhon nu 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes// bzhi ka la yod pa/ yid 'phrog lta bas mi ngom snying sdug pa'i// yid 'ong dri 'dzin shangs kyi sgros gtsang ba// yid can srid 'khor yun ring dub pa rnams// yid kyi ngal stegs bzhin du mtho zhing drangs// dang po gnyis 'dra zhing phyi ma gnyis de bzhin/ rab mdzes pad+ma dkar po'i dog pa ltar// rab tu gang zhing rgyas la 'jam pa yi// nu 'bur shel bum zung gis yid 'phrog pa'i// nu ldan kun gyi gtso mo dbyangs can ma// spel ba/ rnam par mdzes ma rab dang dri med cing*// yid bzhin rgyan gyi gzugs brnyan kun gsal phyir// rnam bkra mthong ba yangs pa'i rdzing bu de// yid 'ong shel gyi me long bstar ba bzhin// thog mtha' gnyis 'dra bar ma gnyis kyang ngo*// ri sras khengs 'phrog 'phags ma khyod zhal la// dri zhim gur kum li khri'i dog pa yis// dri tsam 'gos kyang khur rtsi'i thig le des// ri dwags ri mos mtshan pa'i zla ba skyengs// dang po gnyis mtshungs phyi ma gnyis kyang ngo*// so so skye bo'i nang na'ang skal bzang rigs// so so tha dad mos pas snying brlan te// la la kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin spro bzhin// la la bstod tshig dri za'i rgyud stong bsgreng*// dang po gsum dang gnyis bzhi mtshungs/

gang gang dbyangs can lha mo'i thugs rje'i thugs// de de nyin mtshan dad pas sgom byed na// gang gang blo gros zla tshes yar 'phel te// de de nyid du chos mig dri med thob// snga phyi mtshungs shing bar ma gnyis kyang*/ ma ma byams brtse'i gter mdzod dbyangs can zhabs// yang yang bstod kyang bdag blo tshim pa med// yang yang snying rje'i spyan zur g.yo ba'i phyir// ma ma khyod min bdag la skyabs gzhan su// bar du chod pa'i chod pa/ rlung gzhon gyis bskyod ldem ldem g.yur za ba'i// shel gyi lcug phran ldem ldem g.yo ba bzhin// phra zhing sta zur ldem ldem mdzes pa yi// dbyangs can sked skabs ldem ldem snying du sdug /mtha'i chod pa/ rnam bkra mdangs kyi nor bu'i phra tshom mdzes// rin chen phra yi gser gyi zhabs gdub mdzes// mdzes gdub 'khrol bas zhabs zung rnam par mdzes// zhabs skyes rdul gyi bdag nyid cod pan mdzes// mtha'i chod cing ma chod pa/ bzhad pa'i 'dzum dkar bdud rtsi'i 'od khyug khyug /spyan zur ut+pal sngon po mdangs khyug khyug /mthing gis bris 'dra'i smin dkyus phra khyug khyug /zur mig bung ba'i rnam 'gyur gar khyug khyug /bar mtha'i chod pa/ gur gum chu yis ma bkrus dri bral ma// ke ta'i rdul gtsang ma btab rab gtsang ma// zla zhun thigs pas ma byugs rab dkar ma// zur mig lcags kyus ma btab kun 'gugs ma// bar mthar chod cing ma chod pa/ mtshan dpe'i rgyan mdzes mdzes pa'i sku mdzes mdzes// zla ba'i mdog mdzes mdzes pa'i zhal mdzes mdzes// ut+pal mdangs mdzes mdzes pa'i spyan mdzes mdzes// rgyu skar ltar mdzes mdzes pa'i tshems mdzes mdzes// thog bar na yod pa'i bar chod/ rab mchog nor bu rab bkra'i phreng ba dang*// rab rgyas me tog rab gsal mdangs mdzes pas// rab spras dbu skra rab tu dri zhim pa// rab bcings rtse mo rab dkar zla ba spud// thog bar gyi chod cing ma chod pa/

la la khyod dran la la khyod thos shis// la la khyod mthong la la khyod reg tshe// la la rab dad la la lhag mos pas// la la mchod sprin la la bstod tshig spel// thog mthar chod pa/ ma pham bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal ma// ma lus rgyal ba rgya mtsho bskyed mdzad ma// ma rig mun pa'i smag rum sel mdzad ma// ma rmad grags pa dkar ba'i bcom ldan ma// thog mthar chod cing ma chod pa/ mdzes mdzes zhal bzang lang tsho'i mdangs mdzes mdzes// mdzes mdzes spyan ras ut+pal ltar mdzes mdzes// mdzes mdzes zhal mchu pad+ma'i sgros mdzes mdzes// gsum kar yod pa'i chod pa/ legs legs sku legs legs bris dbyibs legs legs// legs legs phreng legs legs 'dzin de legs legs// legs legs gsung legs legs sgra'i gdangs legs legs// legs legs tshig legs legs pa'i gtam legs legs// mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ dri za'i khye'u dga' ma'i glu dbyangs can// dbyangs can khyod sku zla ltar rab mdzes shing*// mdzes shing lta na sdug mnga' rab mdangs gsal// mdangs gsal nor bu'i do shal rgyan gyis sgeg /kun tu zung ldan las dang po dang gsum/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa zlas pa/ chu skyes dkar pos nyer bsnyen pa'i// dbyangs can ma ni yid du 'ong*// chu skyes dkar pos nyer bsnyen pa'i// dbyangs can ma ni yid du 'ong*// dang po gnyis 'dra zhing gsum pa dang bzhi pa 'dra ba/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum dbang phyug /dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum dbang phyug /gang de gnyis skyes dga' ba'i lha// gang de gnyis skyes dga' ba'i lha// thog mtha' gnyis 'dra zhing bar gnyis mnyam/ pad+ma can dag mdzes pa'i rgyan// dbyangs can bu mo lus dkar ba// dbyangs can bu mo lus dkar ba// pad+ma can dag mdzes pa'i rgyan// mi mnyam par bzlas pa'i rnam grangs/ mgrin sngon can gyi mdza' na mo// mgrin sngon can gyi mdza' na mo// de 'dra gnyis ka'i mdzes sdug ni// 'jig rten kun gyi yid khar 'ong*// gtsang byed las skyes reg bya yis// grang bas nyen pa'i sdug bsngal sel// thog mtha'/

'jig rten kun gyi mun sel zhing*// dge legs snang ba rgyas byed pa'i// nyi ma gza' dang bral ba zhig /skye dgu'i bsod nams dpal du 'bar// drug pa rtsub mo'i/ 'dam skyes sbrang rtsi ma 'thungs kyang*// mthong ba tsam gyi gar rtsen pa'i// bung ba 'di dag nags nang na// rab tu myos pas 'khyams pa bzhin// bdun pa grangs kyi/ rgya mtsho bzhi yi sku dang ni// mda' yi ye shes mchog brnyes pas// 'gro ba dus kyi mgon thub dbang*// chos kyi 'khor lo me ru bskor// yang*/ sde lnga'i gsum dbus shing rta'i sna// sngon 'jug bzhi pas nyer drangs nas// rjes 'brangs dgu pas zhabs brten pa'i// yul yod de na mi'i lag 'gro// mtshan gzhi'i thog ma'i ming can 'dug /brgyad pa/ mdzes ma khyod dang 'grogs pa na// bdag lus spu long gis khyab pa// khyod kyi kha sgo las byung ba'i// tsan dan dri 'di bsil ba'i mthu// ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig rtse mo can la brten pa yi// gtsug phud can de mthong ba na// yid la 'phel ba'i lus med 'di// srid rtse pa min nam mkha' min// sgrib pa'i gab tshig nor bral dbul 'phongs kun dor nas// nor ldan lang tsho can dang 'grogs// skye bo thams cad dga' byed pa// de 'dra gzugs 'tshong ma yin no// mthun pa'i/ zhi'am de sems dul ba yi// rang bzhin dag ni gang yin yang*// dam pa'i skye bo de yis ni// thugs la bdag cag lhag par dad// rmongs byed/ khro bas skyes pa bud med dag /mal stan dag la nyal ba las// 'dod pas kha ni phyir phyogs te// phan tshun mchu yi sbrang chang gzhib// bcu gsum yongs 'phrog dag byed dgra bo'i shing rta ni// bdun ldan yan lag drug pa yi// dpal gyi dpal gyur de shar bas// ku mud gnyen gyi gnyen zum gyur// bcu bzhi pa gcig sgrib pa/ dkar min mi 'jam rin po che'i// gdub bu sil sil ma spras pa'i// na chung min pa 'ga' zhig gi

/lag ni 'gal du ma dogs pa rengs mtshungs// bco lnga pa gnyis ka sgrib pa/ lang tsho yol ba min pa zhig /gang dang mngon par 'grogs pa na// dga' ba'i 'gal zla ma yin pa'i// bya ba mang po 'phel bar 'gyur// bcu drug pa yongs 'dres/ mkhur ba lang tsho'i thig le can// na tshod yol min de nyid kyi// lag pa'i lcug phran mig dag la// gser gdub me tog me te 'khrol// don nyams/ sprin 'di chu yi mngal khur lci// brtan rnams lus med mdas ma phug /sos ka nyi 'od lhag par gdung*// zla ba ri bong gzugs brnyan gsal// don 'gal/ spang rtogs ye shes mthar phyin pa// khyod ni tshogs gsog sgrib byang bas// 'phrin las phyogs ris mi mnga' bar// skal mchog kho na smin par mdzad// don gcig chags dang mngon 'dod 'phel ba yi// yid ni gdung zhing sred byed pa'i// srid ldan lang tshos myos pa de// bdag gi yid la sim zhing dran// the tshom can/ snum zhing mdangs ldan ke sa ras// rab mdzes mgrin pa sngon po can// 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi// dbang phyug nyid de bdag dga'o// rim nyams/ zla ba'i zhal dang tshangs pa'i gsung*// yon tan rin chen gter gyur thugs// dran dang thos dang mthong ba dang*// yid la dang ba'i dngos po 'phel// sgra dman/ sman shar gdong yag ma khyod la// glu gzhas mkhas po do ra'i rgyan// rkub tshos me long phyang phyang de// sgeg nyams de yis sgrib na a// bcod mtshams nyams pa/ phyag gi pad+mar sher phyin po// ti yi bung ba zab mo stong*// nyid kyi glu dbyangs sgrog pa 'jam// dbyangs la gus pa'i glus bstod do// sdeb sbyor nyams pa/ snying sdug mdzes ma khyod la chags ldan gyi// yin ni 'dod pa'i mda' yis bsnun// mtshams sbyor nyams/ rmad byung thugs rje chen po ldan// mgon po zhabs skyes phyag 'tshal lo// yul 'gal ba/ lho nags 'thibs por rgyu ba'i 'brong bu dang*// byang thang 'grim pa'i rgya stag khra bo gnyis// ma ru rtse yi pad+ma'i nags tshal du// lho ra'i

dogs pa rigs las 'ongs pa'i lang tsho ngom// dus 'gal/ snye ma yongs su smin pa dgun gyi dus// mtshan mo nyi zer rnon pos gdungs byas pa'i// lang tsho dar la babs pa'i rgan po zhig /ston gyi khu byug glu dbyangs nyan la spro// rgyu rtsal dang 'gal/ lag pa'i rnam 'gyur 'khyug dang smyu gu yis// 'du byed 'phrul las ma 'ongs yi ge 'dis// grangs su bgrang bar ma bgyis rtsis lugs rnams// mi sdug ro dang ldan pa'i gar zhes bris// 'jig rten dang 'gal ba/ mig sman dkar pos sbyangs pa'i long ba zhig /chu shing snying po'i 'khar ba la brten nas// nam mkha'i me tog 'phreng ba brgyus bzhin du// shing gi rdo khog nang du ja zhig bkol// lung dang 'gal ba/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal kho na zhes// stobs bcu pa yis legs par gsungs bden mod// ri dwags mig ldan gang gi mchu'i sbrang rtsi// gzhibs las bde ba'i ro chen 'di ci ga /rigs pa dang 'gal ba/ gar yang rgyu med 'bras bu'i 'phreng ba ni// srid min dngos stobs rig pas legs grub kyang*// me dang dug gi gnod pas mgron gnyer ba'i// dpal sbas de la rgyal bas phan pa sgrub// yul dus dang 'gal yang skyon med pa'i dpe/ lugs ngan dug gi 'khri shing cher 'khrigs pa'i// rtsed dus 'brog dgon 'dir yang rin chen bdun// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor bsgyur zas gtsang sras// grags pa'i rnga yab dkar pos dbugs 'byin mdzad// dus 'gal gyi dmigs bsal/ grang byed mtshon cha ngar ma mthor rlung gis// rnon por brdar ba snun byed dgun dus kyi// dpa' bo gtum chen khros tshe'ang 'dab ma'i rgya// rgya cher grol ba grong gsar tshal der mthong*// rgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba'i dmigs bsal/ ldab ldib mgrin par chags pas 'gyur khugs kyis// rnam pa gsal min glu dang bro'i stangs stabs// smyon pa'i gar mtshungs 'gas kyang 'dod ldan gyi// bzhin la rgya skyegs khu bas byugs 'drar bzo// 'jig rten dang 'gal yang skyon med pa'i dmigs bsal/
